name: Senda Loto
aka: Buddhist Meditation and Yoga Retreat Center Sierra Nevada

location.address: Near the Calabazo entrance to Tayrona National Park, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
location.region: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia

tradition: Dzogchen tradition of Tibetan Buddhism (Dudjom Tersar lineage), combined with Hatha yoga
technique: Shamatha (calm-abiding) and Vipassana (insight) meditation as taught by Dudjom Rinpoche, supported by Hatha yoga, pranayama, and periods of noble silence
teacherAccess: Guided in person by founder Pema, with daily short dharma talks, Q&A sessions, and guided group meditation; an afternoon social window allows informal access to teachers.
retreatOptions: Fixed 1-week residential retreats (two rotating programs: a gentler 'Mindfulness Meditation & Yoga' retreat and a more intensive 'Buddhist Meditation & Yoga: Deepen Insight' retreat), guided in English and Spanish.
about: Senda Loto is a Buddhist meditation and yoga retreat center in Colombia's Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, five minutes from the Calabazo entrance to Tayrona National Park. Founded by Pema — a practitioner of more than 15 years in the Dzogchen tradition of Tibetan Buddhism who trained under teachers including the Dalai Lama, Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche, and his guru Loppon Jigme Rinpoche — the center offers fixed one-week residential retreats rooted in the Dudjom Tersar lineage. Two programs run on rotation: a gentler 'Mindfulness Meditation & Yoga' retreat centered on Hatha yoga and Shamatha (calm-abiding) practice, and a more intensive 'Buddhist Meditation & Yoga' retreat combining Shamatha and Vipassana (insight) meditation with daily dharma talks, Q&A, and noble silence, closing with a traditional Tibetan fire puja on the beach. Days alternate silent practice with a supervised social window, and retreats include a mindful hike into Tayrona National Park.
schedule: 1-week retreats run Yoga/pranayama at 7am, silent meals, multiple daily meditation sessions, a Wednesday hike in Tayrona National Park, dharma talk/Q&A most evenings, and noble silence overnight; the insight retreat keeps silence throughout except a 2-5pm social window, closing with a Tibetan fire puja on the final night.
cost: Fixed price per person for the 1-week retreat, tiered by room type.

pricePerDay.notes: 1-week retreat: Shared Room $1,080 (~$154/night) to Private Room $1,800 (~$257/night); Private Cabin $2,700 (~$386/night) also available.

foodNotes: Meals are included in the retreat price; guest reviews describe the cuisine as Ayurvedic-inspired.
